source_checks.selector: @Environment locale is read inside View. Tamil language identifier ta selects Typeface.display(28, relativeTo:.largeTitle); regional Tamil identifiers share languageCode ta. Missing/non-Tamil language codes take the unchanged Typeface.display(40) branch.
source_checks.manual_app_selection: SettingsView App language picker calls AppStore.updateSettings, saves settings.language, and updates TimbreLocalization.language. RootView injects TimbreLocalization.locale(for:store.settings.language); an explicit ta returns Locale(identifier:ta). First-run fullScreenCover presents OnboardingView from this root environment; deferred questions inherit the same root locale and do not display welcome.
source_checks.system_selection: For system setting, TimbreLocalization.locale(for:) supplies Locale.current. Apple documents current as the app-effective locale incorporating system settings, app-specific Settings choice and supported localization availability. Therefore the selector follows existing system/iOS per-app language resolution without separately guessing device language. In-app explicit selection overrides system through the root injection.
source_checks.dynamic_type: Typeface.display delegates to sora(.semiBold), then Font.custom(name,size,relativeTo:style). Old40 maps to.largeTitle through Font.TextStyle.matching; new Tamil28 explicitly retains.largeTitle rather than implicitly changing its curve to.title. This remains scalable custom font, not fixedSize font or minimumScaleFactor. Existing BoldText heavier-face selection is unchanged.
source_checks.other_locales: All non-ta branches return the exact previous Typeface.display(40). No other locale typography, fallback font, DynamicType cap, lineLimit or global theme rule changes.
source_checks.text: Same literal source key, tracking(-1), foregroundStyle, fixedSize(horizontal:false,vertical:true), isHeader trait and onboarding.headline identifier remain. Entire Tamil Localizable.strings is byte-identical to970a12d, including words, two periods and one newline.
source_checks.scale: 28 and40 are both existing TypeStep point values. No CI/design-system rule or baseline adjustment is needed. The code names28 literally, allowing the hygiene scanner to assess it honestly.
source_checks.isolation_build: Synchronous computed Font reads a normal SwiftUI environment value; no mutable cache, geometry feedback, Task, new API dependency, actor annotation or cross-test state is introduced.
